strategies.name: overnight_range_break_retest_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Mark the overnight/pre-market high and low, then wait during the New York session for price to break above the overnight high with strength or below the overnight low with weakness. After the break, enter on a pullback/retest of that level once the retest shows confirming price action in the break's
strategies.exit_summary: Initial stop goes on the opposite side of the breakout level: below the prior overnight high for longs, above the prior overnight low for shorts. Manage winners by taking profit when satisfied and/or moving the stop to break even after trimming; the speaker also shows examples measured around 1.5R-2
